answers.Q2_subj07_discordance_localized_or_wide: PARTICIPANT_WIDE: subj07 has 1/7 ROIs with L_perf_RAW>0 (median S_perf=-0.033); reliability loss positive in 5/7 -> discordance is a participant-wide RAW-performance shift, not one ROI.
answers.Q4_heterogeneity_global_vs_spatial: MAD S_perf across participants=0.005 vs median within-participant MAD_perf=0.051; within-participant ROI variation dominates
answers.Q5_depends_on_one_participant: NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_DESCRIPTIVE_PATTERN: leave-one-participant rho positive in 7/7 (min 0.600, max 0.714); the positive DIRECTION is robust to removing any one participant. (The frozen criterion C was not met; this is not a significance statement.)
answers.Q6_median_created_the_result: MIXED: frozen median rho=0.679 vs prespecified mean-aggregation rho=0.393; both positive; ordering is somewhat aggregation-dependent but not sign-reversing. Median is the frozen primary and is not re-chosen.
answers.Q7_measurement_size_dominates: MIXED: rho(median_nvox,S_perf)=+0.445, rho(median_nvox,S_rel_img)=+0.148 (no residualization; primary effect not corrected).

descriptive_mechanism_statement: H-A captured a robust DIRECTIONAL component of beta-version sensitivity (leave-one-participant rho positive 7/7) but does not fully explain participant heterogeneity; subj07 is VALID heterogeneity (a low-baseline RAW regime), not a technical failure. A broader beta-preparation reliability factor involving BOTH vision and imagery remains plausible. NOT causal; NOT a population claim; frozen criterion C was not met.
